name: Elevator Arrest
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Tap his head to grease the bars.
Drag the notice board between the bars.
Use the baguette to pry the bars apart.
Tap the plunger to pull the bars.
Drag the mouse to the repairman.
Feed the pizza to the trapped man.
Tap the upside-down worker to add pressure.
Tap the tools to loosen the railing screws.
Tap the elevator panel to summon the ghost.
